steps.title: Analyze Build Error Logs
steps.description: Inspect the compilation logs to locate Resource Compilation errors.

steps.title: Validate Color Resources
steps.description: Inspect colors.xml and strings.xml for invalid color value formats.

steps.title: Remove Invalid Color Declaration
steps.description: Delete the incorrect color element named app_name with non-hex value from strings.xml.

steps.title: Inspect Layout XML files
steps.description: Scan layout XMLs to ensure all layout_width and layout_height attributes contain valid parameters.

steps.title: Correct Layout Dimension Syntax
steps.description: Replace match_match with match_parent in activity_main.xml to resolve layout parsing issues.

steps.title: Verify Android Namespace
steps.description: Confirm correct Android namespace URL is used inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Validate Theme References
steps.description: Ensure styles, themes, and design structures conform to traditional system material light theme standards.

steps.title: Verify WaveformView Implementation
steps.description: Ensure custom UI view uses standard math calculations without compile-time syntax warnings.

steps.title: Verify Audio Permission Workflow
steps.description: Ensure runtime permissions for microphone audio capture are properly requested.

steps.title: Building Voice Assistant AI
steps.description: Compile the modified project with Gradle and verify a successful build.
